# Accessibility Rules

- Use semantic HTML and accessible names.
- All functions must be available through keyboard unless inherently device-specific.
- Maintain visible focus and logical focus order.
- Manage focus for dialogs, menus and route changes.
- Respect reduced motion preferences.
- Verify text and non-text contrast against rendered backgrounds.
- Do not use color as the only state indicator.
- Support zoom and reflow without loss of content/functionality.
- Test controls with screen reader semantics and error announcements.
- Record applicable WCAG target level and justified exceptions: TBD.
